title: The Lord Is My Light and My Salvation

questions.question: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:1 (ESV): "The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?"

questions.question: The Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:1 (ESV): "The Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?"

questions.question: When evildoers assail me to eat up my flesh, my adversaries and foes, it is they who stumble and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:2 (ESV): "...it is they who stumble and fall."

questions.question: Though an army encamp against me, my heart shall not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:3 (ESV): "Though an army encamp against me, my heart shall not fear;"

questions.question: One thing have I asked of the Lord, that will I seek after: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord when?
options: All the days of my life
questions.correctAnswer: All the days of my life
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:4 (ESV): "...that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life,"

questions.question: To gaze upon the beauty of the Lord and to inquire in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:4 (ESV): "...to gaze upon the beauty of the Lord and to inquire in his temple."

questions.question: For he will hide me in his shelter in the day of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:5 (ESV): "For he will hide me in his shelter in the day of trouble;"

questions.question: He will conceal me under the cover of his tent; he will lift me high upon a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:5 (ESV): "...he will lift me high upon a rock."

questions.question: And now my head shall be lifted up above my enemies all around me, and I will offer in his tent sacrifices with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:6 (ESV): "...and I will offer in his tent sacrifices with shouts of joy;"

questions.question: You have said, "Seek my face." My heart says to you, "Your face, Lord, do I what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:8 (ESV): "You have said, 'Seek my face.' My heart says to you, 'Your face, Lord, do I seek.'"

questions.question: Hide not your face from me. Turn not your servant away in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:9 (ESV): "Hide not your face from me. Turn not your servant away in anger,"

questions.question: For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord will what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:10 (ESV): "For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord will take me in."

questions.question: Teach me your way, O Lord, and lead me on a level path because of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:11 (ESV): "...lead me on a level path because of my enemies."

questions.question: Give me not up to the will of my adversaries; for false witnesses have risen against me, and they breathe out what?
I believe that I shall look upon the goodness of the Lord in the land of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 27:13 (ESV): "I believe that I shall look upon the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living!"

key_verse_text: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
